title: Proportional control leaves a steady-state error
caption: With C = 4 the loop gain is L(0) = 8, so the closed-loop step response settles at 8/9 ≈ 0.889 and misses the reference 1 by 1/(1 + 8) = 1/9 ≈ 0.111.
alt: A step response rising quickly and levelling at 0.889, below the dashed reference line at 1.
description: The loop gain at zero frequency is L(0) = 2 × 4 = 8.
The closed loop is T(s) = 8/(s + 9), so T(0) = 8/9 ≈ 0.889.
The step ends short of the reference by 1/(1 + 8) = 1/9 ≈ 0.111.
